In figure $ABCDEF$ shown above, which of the following are equal to the vector $\overset{\to }{DF}?$

- $\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{CB}+\overset{\to }{BF}$
- $\overset{\to }{FB}-\overset{\to }{DB}$
- $\overset{\to }{DE}+\overset{\to }{EF}$

In figure $ABCD$ shown above, which of the following are equal to the vector $\overset{\to }{DB}?$

- $\overset{\to }{DA}+\overset{\to }{AC}+\overset{\to }{CB}$
- $\overset{\to }{DA}+\overset{\to }{AB}$
- $\overset{\to }{BA}-\overset{\to }{CA}+\overset{\to }{CD}$
feedback.worked_solution:
- For the $1$st expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{DA}+\overset{\to }{AC}+\overset{\to }{CB} & =(\overset{\to }{DA}+\overset{\to }{AC})+\overset{\to }{CB} \\  & =\overset{\to }{DC}+\overset{\to }{CB} \\  & =\overset{\to }{DB}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

- For the $2$nd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{DA}+\overset{\to }{AB} & =\overset{\to }{DB}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

- For the $3$rd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BA}-\overset{\to }{CA}+\overset{\to }{CD} & =(\overset{\to }{BA}-\overset{\to }{CA})+\overset{\to }{CD} \\  & =(\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AC})+\overset{\to }{CD} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BC}+\overset{\to }{CD} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BD} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{DB}\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and II only".
